pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Ich mag keine Cola" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like cola
   B. I drink cola every day
   C. I am buying cola
   D. I do not like cola

2. How is the letter P named in German? (1 mark)
   A. oo
   B. iks
   C. ess
   D. pay

3. Which German name belongs to the mark "!"? (1 mark)
   A. das Komma
   B. das Ausrufezeichen
   C. der Punkt
   D. das Fragezeichen

4. Which German word must begin with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. Mutter
   C. nett
   D. und

5. What does "vor dem Haus" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in the house
   B. behind the house
   C. under the house
   D. in front of the house

6. What does "die Dusche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pot
   B. cooker
   C. living room
   D. shower

7. Which room name contains the letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Zimmer
   B. Küche
   C. Flur
   D. Garten

8. What does "sonnig" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cool
   B. dry
   C. foggy
   D. sunny

9. In "Wir essen zusammen", what does zusammen mean? (1 mark)
   A. later
   B. alone
   C. together
   D. early

10. How is the letter G named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ay
   B. gay
   C. emm
   D. koo

11. What does "Bitte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you tomorrow
   B. please
   C. good night
   D. bye (friendly)

12. What do you label on a floor plan? (1 mark)
   A. the meals
   B. the days
   C. the weather
   D. the rooms

13. Which song teaches "Kopf, Schulter, Knie und Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. A birthday song
   B. The action song about body parts
   C. A song about the weather
   D. A song about days

14. Which word means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tanten
   B. die Kinder
   C. die Eltern
   D. die Geschwister

15. Which is the correct spelling for fruit? (1 mark)
   A. Öbst
   B. Obts
   C. Opst
   D. Obst

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

18. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

20. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — I do not like cola
   keine shows that the person does not like cola.

2. D — pay
   In German the letter P is called pay.

3. B — das Ausrufezeichen
   ! is the exclamation mark, das Ausrufezeichen.

4. B — Mutter
   German nouns always begin with a capital letter.

5. D — in front of the house
   vor means in front of.

6. D — shower
   die Dusche means shower.

7. B — Küche
   Küche has ü.

8. D — sunny
   sonnig means sunny.

9. C — together
   zusammen means together.

10. B — gay
   In German the letter G is called gay.

11. B — please
   Bitte means please.

12. D — the rooms
   A floor plan is a picture of the rooms seen from above.

13. B — The action song about body parts
   The song names head, shoulders, knees and feet.

14. C — die Eltern
   Eltern are the mother and father together.

15. D — Obst
   The word is Obst.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.
